packageRules.description: A published package's minimum Python is a promise to its users: it moves only when we drop a version, never in a dependency update
The same for the go directive in go.mod, the Go module's minimum Go
The same for the SDK constraint in pubspec.yaml, the Dart package's minimum Dart
hold until 2026-12-26: hron's public API takes jiff::Zoned, which jiff 1.0 renames, so moving to it breaks hron's users; owner decides when hron takes it
